generalized_findings.classification: Unsupported numeric metadata and nested record relations escape the boundary

generalized_findings.classification: Negation and explanatory ownership are confused
generalized_findings.evidence: Not a union invents a text exclusion; exclude prices becomes broad text; removing online access fails to produce the required negative format predicate.
generalized_findings.next_requirement: Negation must bind to a semantic domain and governing speech act; metalinguistic negation is not a retrieval exclusion.

generalized_findings.classification: Benign context/advisory paraphrases overblock and contaminate topic transport
generalized_findings.evidence: 47/67 valid searches blocked;38 IR_UNSUPPORTED,7 IR_AMBIGUOUS,2 IR_INCOMPLETE. Source-role/modality agreement is low and semantic strings retain framing prose.
generalized_findings.next_requirement: Stabilize grammatical segments and source roles, preserving free topical text and advisory preferences without inventing hard metadata.
